manufacturer.name: Hörmann
manufacturer.note: German door and operator manufacturer. Search surfaced only third-party copies of its operator manuals, so no manufacturer-hosted document URL is claimed below. Hörmann publishes per market: hormann.us serves US documents through a hashed download handler, while the UK and EU documents found so far are all on resellers. Series numbers matter here - SupraMatic E2, S, Series 3 and P Series 4 are different operators, not editions of one, and are recorded separately.
